facts.fact: Tchadinfos reports Camtel supplies capacity from its Kribi landing station, from which Chad's operators draw their international capacity.

Tchadinfos reports Camtel committed to supply Safitel capacity gradually, up to 200 G within six months, and to give Safitel and Sotel access to its monitoring platform for capacity supplied from Kribi.
Tchadinfos reports Chad's international capacity is supplied from Kribi in Cameroon over Camtel's fibre, with second routes Nana-Mberé and Yagoua-Bongor still to be completed.
